result.title: Trading Parameters for Accuracy in MambaVision for Chest Radiograph Classification
result.comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 9 tables. Submitted to an IEEE journal
result.summary: MambaVision, a hybrid state-space and attention backbone, places most of its parameters in its widest, fourth stage. We quantified what that stage contributes to multi-label chest radiograph classification. The fourth stage was replaced with lighter single-scan state-space blocks adapted from Spatial-Mamba, with multi-scale dilated depthwise convolutions applied to the scan output; the first three stages were retained. Tiny, Small, and Base models were evaluated across nine dataset-scale combinations drawn from two source cohorts: the National Institutes of Health ChestX-ray14 archive (full ChestMNIST and a high-resolution subset) and Indiana University Open-i. At the Tiny scale, replacement reduced parameter count by 35.7% and increased graphics processing unit throughput by 19.3%; the savings came from the stage's dense projections, not from removing quadratic attention. Without distillation, the mean area under the receiver operating characteristic curve on ChestMNIST was 0.004 lower than the baseline (95% bootstrap confidence interval, 0.002 to 0.006), and 0.003 to 0.006 lower across all nine combinations. Knowledge distillation from an unreplaced teacher narrowed the gap to the undistilled baseline to 0.001-0.002 and met the equivalence criterion on ChestMNIST, but distilling the baseline with the same recipe improved it by 0.001-0.003, so a gap of 0.002-0.005 persisted under symmetric training. At the Base scale, the unreplaced Small model was both smaller and more accurate. Fourth-stage replacement is a useful trade-off only for Tiny and Small models. These measurements let developers of chest radiograph screening tools weigh model size and speed against a quantified loss of diagnostic discrimination.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文用轻量单扫描状态空间块替换 MambaVision 的第四阶段，量化其在胸片多标签分类中参数量、吞吐与 ROC AUC 的取舍，并考察知识蒸馏能否弥补差距。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于医学影像分类的骨干网络效率与精度权衡，未涉及 latent 推理状态、视觉证据使用或 THINK/LOOK/STOP 等决策机制，也未提供可核查的状态表示或推理过程线索，故排除。
